title: Sales & CS Request Aggregator — scoping framework and triage rubric for enterprise asks
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create an operational pattern and tooling for aggregating feature requests from Sales and Customer Success, performing an initial product/engineering scoping pass, and surfacing prioritized enterprise asks to Product and Solutions Engineering. This ticket captures the proposed framework, intake form, scoring rubric, dashboard fields, and handoff expectations so that CS/AEs get timely responses and Product has a repeatable funnel of scoping-ready requests.
acceptance_criteria: A shared intake form is published and linked in the CS/Sales playbook
An automated aggregation endpoint (CSV/Slack webhook) populates the intake dashboard
Every new enterprise request receives an initial triage entry with score and triage owner within 3 business days
A deterministic pass/fail for 'scoping-ready' is defined and used during handoff to ENG
Product and Solutions Engineering agree on the scoring weights and a sample of 10 historical asks is rescored to sanity-check prioritization
proposed_workflow: 1) CS/AE completes the standardized intake form attached to Salesforce/Hub; 2) requests automatically appear in the intake dashboard and Slack #pm-intake with a triage token; 3) triage rota (PM + 1 SE) reviews within 72 hours, assigns an initial score and tags 'scoping-ready' or 'more-info'; 4) 'scoping-ready' items are batched weekly into the product backlog grooming lane; 5) 'more-info' items generate a templated follow-up to the CS/AE. Workflow includes mandatory fields for customer size, contract stage, data sensitivity, and requested timeline.
intake_form_fields: AE/CS contact name and Slack handle
Data sensitivity classification (none | low | high | regulated)
scoring_rubric: Impact (0-10): revenue/ARR and strategic customer importance
Effort (0-10): rough engineering cost estimate from SE during triage
Risk/Compliance lift (0-5): data sensitivity, legal, or infra constraints
Customer Continuity (0-5): does lack of feature risk churn or renewal?
Platform Fit (0-5): aligns with core product roadmap or a bespoke request
Score formula: weighted sum = 0.5*Impact - 0.3*Effort - 0.2*Risk + PlatformFit + CustomerContinuity. Thresholds: >=6.0 scoping-ready, 4.0-5.9 needs more info, <4 deprioritize
dashboard_fields: Current status (new | more-info | scoping-ready | in-backlog | closed)
Linked artifacts (Confluence PRD, demo recording, contract excerpt)
